title: Developmental Red Flags Beyond Routine Milestones
subject: Developmental Milestones
preview: Loss of previously attained skills is a developmental red flag at any age.
quickRevision: Loss of previously attained skills is a developmental red flag at any age.
Hearing and vision problems can mimic or compound developmental delays.
Use validated screening tools and assess family concerns rather than waiting for a rigid age cutoff.

sections.title: Essential distinctions
points: Loss of previously attained skills is a developmental red flag at any age.
Delayed milestones are interpreted across language, social, gross-motor and fine-motor domains.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Regression of speech or social engagement warrants assessment even if some motor milestones are normal.
